authority: skills/l-01-agent-lifecycles/SKILL.md (thin role-capsule router) · this file is routing metadata only

routing_conditions.condition: The AR role launcher or the role_start tool supplies one supported role and one applicable operation.
routing_conditions.task_from: only canonical task references supplied in the handover
routing_conditions.never_selects: an inferred role, task, repository, parent, or default operation
routing_conditions.fail_closed_when: role or operation is missing, unsupported, or inapplicable, or supplied bindings conflict

routing_conditions.condition: Architect or System Specialist is explicitly selected for a manual Projects launch with no task binding.
routing_conditions.selects: the supplied role and one applicable operation
routing_conditions.task_from: none; no synthetic task reference is created
routing_conditions.requires: ask only for a missing outcome/repository or system concern/report scope

orientation.purpose: Read the supplied role binding and durable inputs; ask only for missing taskless target facts.

planning.purpose: Shape a bounded plan and requirement set; Architect delegation starts with one Manager for one master, one Orchestrator for concurrent masters, unless the developer chooses otherwise.

implementation.purpose: Implement one selected leaf and report its change and verification evidence.

review.purpose: Independently review the complete assigned candidate or sealed fix-verification scope.

curation.purpose: Reconcile intent, code, reports, onboarding, and admitted knowledge for one leaf.

coordination.purpose: Start and message role agents on the Paseo host against exact canonical AR task references.

authorized-closeout.purpose: Coordinate the existing authorized paired code/memory closeout with its exact evidence.

recovery.purpose: Resume the same task and the same role agents; reconcile uncertainty before retrying.

bootstrap.purpose: The new user's first hour: the memory repository from nothing to a resolving context, and the failure states a new user actually hits.

authority.purpose: Seat authority, seat binding, immutability, the dispatch transaction, takeover, the escalation ladder, clarification triage, delegated series authority, the decision relay.

invariants.purpose: The shared invariants every role can count on, the task-doc/branch/worktree spine, default behavior, knob resolution, instruction-surface boundaries.

lifecycle-frame.purpose: The minimal lifecycle frame: the six signals, which seats run them, the trust checkpoint, provider-degradation handling.

loop.purpose: The three-party loop doctrine, tiers, rounds and convergence, criteria catalogs, per-level agent sets, requirement compilation before topology.

acceptance.purpose: Completion truth vs acceptance, the per-seat handoff artifact table, per-ID acceptance envelopes, attempt lineage, the durable-evidence promotion hold point.

launcher.purpose: The ambient launcher's own obligations, authored here so the role registry holds only roles.

architect.seat: Projects-level semantic owner; may be launched taskless; delegates one master to one Manager and concurrent masters to one Orchestrator, unless the developer chooses otherwise.

orchestrator.seat: Sprint coordinator above one Manager per concurrently worked master; also available above a single master when the developer explicitly asks.

designer.seat: a HAT the architect pulls inline, or an optional separate sprint chair; evidence-backed problem framing at the assigned scope

strategist.seat: the sprint planner, spawn-first under the architect's propose-first question; reader, not mutator

manager.seat: Selected-master coordinator and decision owner under the Architect for one master or the Orchestrator for concurrent masters.

worker.seat: One selected leaf implementation owner in the AR-paired task enclosure.

curator.seat: Curator for one selected leaf memory/onboarding scope and admitted knowledge records.

reviewer.seat: Independent reviewer for one selected leaf candidate and named requirement.

system-specialist.seat: Taskless Projects provider/system investigator; reports before authorized remediation.

bootstrap.seat: the new user's first-hour seat; sets one repository up through the surfaces that own each step and reports what actually happened

rationale.description: Reference-only: rationale, provenance, and credits consolidated out of the normative path.

rulings.description: Reference-only: durable developer rulings and the superseded rules they replace, with citations.

lenses.description: The four job lenses the scoping seats read. Reference material for the architect, orchestrator, and designer; a dispatched role never picks a lens.

criteria.description: The reviewer criteria catalogs, bound per review type by operations/review.md and roles/reviewer.md.

templates.description: Field schemas for dispatch briefs and handoff artifacts, and the plan/report template library for the seats that compile them.

notes: Routing metadata only: the role route composes exactly one role source and one applicable operation source.
The frozen core map remains metadata for compiler compatibility; shared core blocks are not injected into role capsules.
Canonical task references and workspace bindings travel in the handover as data, separate from instruction blocks.
The compiler vocabulary retains ten role ids and nine operation ids; the role launcher exposes only the seven current UI roles.
Paseo is the host. Role agents start and message each other with the AR tools role_start and role_message on the agents-remember-task tool server.
